cagents-cagents:lever:48a5ded1-678f-4a3d.description: Job Description: Commissioning Manager - Japan CAI Overview: Are You Ready? CAI is a professional services company established in 1996 that has grown year over year to nearly 700 people worldwide. For Life Sciences and Mission Critical industries that need to deliver critical solutions in high-stakes environments, we provide accelerated operational readiness and unparalleled performance at the highest standard through our rigorous approach, field-tested processes, and elite expertise developed over 30 years. Our approach is simple because ourPurpose informs everything we do: We exist to be the trusted solution for our clients as they strive to build a better working world and improve human experience. At CAI, we are committed to living our Foundational Principles, both professionally and personally: We act with integrity We serve each other We serve society We work for our future At CAI, we believe in a relentless dedication to excellence, pushing boundaries and surpassing expectations. From the beginning, we’ve challenged ourselves to do what others wouldn’t. Not just setting industry standards but redefining them entirely. We are bold in our thinking and creative in our approach. We operate at the intersection of wisdom and technology and thrive when they come together with humanity. For us, operational readiness isn’t simply a goal. It’s a way of life. The role ensures that all critical systems are commissioned safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project specifications, client requirements, and industry best practices. Working closely with clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and project teams, the Commissioning Manager will drive system readiness, testing, validation, and successful project handover while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities: Lead and manage all commissioning, testing, and validation activities within the contracted scope of works, including HVAC, cooling systems, airflow management, hydronic systems, chilled water, refrigerant and return piping, plumbing systems, UPS, DC systems, Generators, Transformers, HV/LV Switchboards, HV/LV Electrical distribution system, Security system, Automatizations systems, BMS and EPMS systems and associated infrastructure. Act as the primary commissioning lead on assigned projects, providing technical leadership throughout commissioning, startup, integrated systems testing, and project closeout. Coordinate commissioning activities with clients, contractors, consultants, equipment manufacturers, and project stakeholders to ensure successful project execution and alignment with commissioning objectives. Provide technical advice and recommendations regarding system performance, operational readiness, commissioning methodologies, constructability, sequencing, resource planning, and risk mitigation. Review designs, technical submittals, equipment documentation, and commissioning deliverables to verify compliance with project specifications, Owner's Project Requirements (OPR), Basis of Design (BoD), and applicable industry standards. Develop, review, and implement commissioning documentation including Commissioning Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), pre-functional checklists, functional performance tests (FPTs), integrated systems tests (ISTs), test scripts, commissioning procedures, commissioning schedules and client Maintenance Operation Procedures (MOP). jobgether-jobgether:lever:42aa9b81-e0ef-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:42aa9b81-e0ef-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Australia. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. Strong understanding of physical-product operations, including lead times, purchase orders, landed costs, inventory, fulfillment, manufacturing, and 3PL relationships.

jobDescription.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6df6d256-1a32-.title: Student Researchers
jobgether-jobgether:lever:6df6d256-1a32-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for Student Researchers based in Romania. This role offers students the opportunity to contribute to research supporting racial, social, and economic justice across Europe. You’ll work on research that can inform strategic litigation, community engagement, and approaches to challenging structural inequalities. Assignments may cover legal systems, case law, regulations, litigation opportunities, and innovative models of movement lawyering. You’ll receive guidance and feedback while developing research outputs that are clear, structured, and useful to a mission-driven team. The work is remote, flexible, and organised around research needs as they arise. It is particularly suited to students who combine strong analytical and writing skills with a genuine interest in justice-focused legal work. Conduct legal and other research supporting initiatives focused on racial, social, and economic justice. Map opportunities and barriers to bringing cases addressing racial, social, and economic justice issues across Europe. Research and analyse relevant laws, regulations, jurisprudence, and legal developments that may inform strategic litigation. Research case management solutions and approaches that could support effective litigation work. Collect, analyse, and summarise information on effective models for movement lawyering and communities of practice. Present research findings and outputs in clear, comprehensive, and structured formats. Work with the team to clarify research questions, establish appropriate methodologies, and determine effective formats for research outputs. Complete assignments according to mutually agreed timelines, with tasks allocated on an ad hoc basis according to organisational needs. Incorporate feedback and guidance to strengthen the quality, relevance, and accessibility of research. Requirements: Strong research, legal analysis, and writing skills, with the ability to process complex information and communicate findings clearly. Ability to present comprehensive legal and non-legal research in a structured, concise, and accessible manner. Demonstrated understanding or strong interest in racial, social, and economic justice issues. Some familiarity with strategic litigation and its potential role in addressing systemic inequalities. Familiarity with European legal systems, laws, regulations, and/or jurisprudence. Strong written and spoken English, as English is the working language. Proficiency in another European language is considered an advantage. Ability to work independently while responding effectively to guidance, feedback, and changing research needs. A thoughtful and critical approach to questions of anti-oppression, intersectionality, and justice. Availability within or close to the CET time zone is an advantage. Benefits: €18 per hour remuneration under a temporary consultancy arrangement. Initial three-month consultancy term , with the possibility of extension where additional research needs remain. Flexible working hours designed to accommodate studies, personal commitments, and remote work. Fully remote working environment. Generally available collaboration window between 11:00 and 16:00 CET , with flexibility outside these hours. Opportunity to contribute to research with potential relevance to strategic litigation and systemic change. Supervision, feedback, and support from an experienced team throughout research assignments. Task-based workload, with the number of hours agreed according to the requirements of each assignment. Applications are reviewed at the beginning of each quarter, with no fixed application deadline. southparkcommons-socket:ashbyhq:0b13de87.description: About Us Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Your primary role will be to bridge the gap between our sales team and potential clients, sparking interest and initiating conversations about our security tool. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 1+ years of sales experience, preferably in a sales development role within the security industry. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage and excite potential clients about our product. - Self-motivated and extremely ambitious, with a drive to achieve sales targets. - Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and to use problem-solving skills to overcome any challenges. - Experience using CRM software to track and analyze sales data. NICE TO HAVES - Knowledge of open source software and/or software development. - Familiarity with Socket's products and services. - Previous experience working in a fast-growing startup environment. Our Interview Process: 1. Phone Screen with our Talent Team (30) 2. Virtual f2f with the Hiring Manager (30) 3. Virtual f2f Mock Interview & Peer Interview (90) 4. Virtual f2f with our Head of Sales (30) 5. Debrief 6. Final call with our Founder (30) 7. References 8. Decision/Offer Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy https://socket.dev/hiring-philosophyand how we approach the process at Socket. We offer: - Market competitive salary bands - Meaningful equity program - Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage) - Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge - Paid parental leave - Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites At Socket, we 1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction. 2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action. 3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions. 4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve. 5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains. 6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:78bb6733-15e.title: Project Epsilon - Spanish (Spain) Quality Control Specialist
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:78bb6733-15e.description: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented Quality Control (QC) Specialist to support an AI data annotation project. In this role, you will review the work submitted by Trainers — pre-seeded questions paired with images and their corresponding "golden" answers — to confirm accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines. This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are highly meticulous, observant, and skilled at spotting errors or inconsistencies that others may miss. What You'll Do Review completed tasks submitted by Trainers, including the original question, the image, and the golden answer provided Independently verify whether the golden answer is correct based on the image Identify and flag incorrect, incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent answers Provide clear, constructive feedback or corrections to help maintain overall data quality Track recurring error patterns and report them to the project team Ensure Trainer output meets the project's quality bar before final sign-off Escalate unclear cases (e.g., illegible images, ambiguous questions) to the project team for resolution What We're Looking For Native/Strong proficiency at Spanish Bachelor's degree required Excellent attention to detail and a strong quality mindset Good visual observation and reading comprehension skills Ability to apply guidelines/rubrics consistently and objectively Strong written English communication skills, especially for giving feedback Prior experience in quality assurance, quality control, editing, proofreading, data review, data annotation or data labeling is a plus Reliable access to a computer and internet connection Work Format & Compensation Work Type: freelance, remote Hours/Schedule: 20 hours per week Compensation: $39.6/hr Duration: Long-term
